1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of __greater than 500 Da and less than 2000 Da__ and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a __different__ multivalent cation crosslinker.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is __a derivative of polyethylenimine. 

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is __selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and excluding anionic surfactants__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising __at least one__ monovalent or divalent cation selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, wherein said ions are present in an __effective amount__ to stabilize the polyelectrolyte complex.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __having a molecular weight in a range of about 600 to 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __with a molecular weight greater than 100 Da__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising __at least one of Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al. 

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __that can undergo crosslinking reactions with the cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid. 

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or __copolymers __of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __with an average molecular weight in the range of 50,000 to 1,000,000 Da__. 

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is __water, brine or seawater__.
